snippet.title: Loading... - Official Demo Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: You are 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games. Get another look at Loading... in this new trailer for the upcoming action-adventure RPG. Loading... will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
